title: Finish preserving review #513: resume saved work of #518 and pass the corrected check
body:
## Goal
Finish task #518 from its saved work; do not redo it. This session starts from `task/518` (tag `iter/0103/518`, commit `67412de`), where both outputs are already written: `docs/research/poc/pair/review-0102.json` (byte-for-byte copy of the #513 review artifact, SHA256 `562467370d558b15eb9a7faf8cb1bc283365f99ef3c8cada9c6f54f1ead8249f`) and `docs/research/poc/pair/review-0102-provenance.md`. #518 was blocked only because its verification command asserted eight probes while the hash-verified artifact lists nine (report #518); that count was the shaper's error, not a defect of the artifact. The corrected command below asserts no probe count. Expected gain: the independent pair-tool review becomes a committed record on main, which the next shaper checks by reading this task's report status and the two files. Report, do not fix: the artifact stays unchanged and minor finding R1 stays open. No session can run LabVIEW; this task establishes no native behaviour, semantic edit or save-version preservation.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Both files exist on the starting branch; `review-0102.json` still has the SHA256 above. If either is missing, report blocked with the exact missing path and the branch head; do not reconstruct the review.
- [ ] The verification command below passes without editing `review-0102.json` or any of the four reviewed files (`pair_diff.py`, `protocol.md`, `owner-instructions.md`, `selfcheck.json` under `docs/research/poc/pair/`).
- [ ] `review-0102-provenance.md` states the probe count exactly as the artifact lists it and says that #513's report text and task #518 said eight; edit only that wording if it is not already accurate.
- [ ] No other file is changed. Do not rerun probes or the pair_diff self-check, author VIs, file an owner request, or commit manually.
## Verification
python3 -c "import json,hashlib,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('docs/research/poc/pair/review-0102.json'); assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='562467370d558b15eb9a7faf8cb1bc283365f99ef3c8cada9c6f54f1ead8249f'; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d['schema_version']==1 and d['reviewed_commit']=='8f5ae4c48581459aa09b3f5e56f79db56188b86c'; assert d['verdict']=='closed' and not any(f['severity']=='major' for f in d['findings']); assert len(d['files'])==4; assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(k).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v for k,v in d['files'].items()); assert d['probes'] and all(q['status']=='passed' for q in d['probes']); assert d['limitations']; assert pathlib.Path('docs/research/poc/pair/review-0102-provenance.md').read_text().strip()"
The command needs only committed files, no prepared sources or session artifacts.
## Context
- Report of #518 (read by the shaper): hash, reviewed commit, four file pins, copy and provenance are done; the only failure was `len(d['probes'])==8` against nine listed probes, the ninth named `protocol_blocks_virtual_execution`.
- Record `0103`: #518 ended `blocked`, unmerged, branch `task/518`, commit `67412de`.
- Owner request #516 (eight controlled VIs) is pending; do not duplicate it or wait for it.
## Budget
Read only `docs/research/poc/pair/review-0102.json` and `docs/research/poc/pair/review-0102-provenance.md`. Hash the four reviewed files through the verification command; do not read their content. No history search, no prepared sources, no large JSON. Run the verification first and report early.
